findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: The previous LoggerMiddleware explicitly added `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` as the `traceID` field on each completed plugin request log. That logic was removed, but the replacement contextual attributes contain only endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user values; `instrumentContext` does not add the trace ID. `LoggerMiddleware` now only reads these contextual attributes via `FromContext`, so requests with an active trace will lose the `traceID` log field and can no longer be correlated with traces as before. Add the trace ID to the contextual attributes (when present) or retain explicit trace-ID logging.
